'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Philip Reyna LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Philip Reyna]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
